articles.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
articles.description: Brand is told to expect a prison sentence "of some length" and faces more rape allegations, it can now be reported.

articles.title: Watch: Met Police release Brand interview footage
articles.description: Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three sexual assaults at Southwark Crown Court.

articles.title: Henry Nowak’s killer has minimum term increased to 25 years by Court of Appeal
articles.description: Judges ruled Vickrum Digwa's original term was unduly lenient and refused his bid to have it cut.

articles.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
articles.description: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.
